description: Report card for one agent, written for its operator: what lcas found when it last read the registration file and checked each endpoint, as problems, warnings, tips and passes, each with a suggested fix. Use it to see why an agent is not listed or not working in lcas. Built from stored checks; nothing is re-checked.
